title: Explicit Project filter mapping
description: Uses a unique PROJECT_MAPPING_PREFIX and an unavailable account to verify source draft editing and activation guards through real browser and gateway paths. It does not claim successful GitHub Project discovery.

setup.intent: A disabled Project source with an unsupported filter cannot enable or emit actions.

navigate.intent: Team source setup is available in the real connected dashboard.

panel.intent: PR automation controls are available independently of active runs.

rules.intent: The operator can inspect the saved Project source draft.

edit.intent: Open the draft created by the gateway fixture without changing source membership.

unmapped.intent: The unsupported term is visible with the activation restriction.

map.intent: The operator explicitly maps the single-quoted open-state filter.

apply.intent: Confirm the visible state-equals-open predicate for the original term.

mapped-visible.intent: The source records that this term was explicitly mapped.

show.intent: The original filter and explicit predicate are readable together.

capture.intent: The evidence shows the retained original term and mapped condition.

save.intent: Persist the mapping without enabling the rule or broadening the source.

saved.intent: The team edit has returned to the saved inventory.

verify.intent: Gateway reads prove term preservation and continued access checks before activation.
